summary: Practise React Native components, navigation, REST integration, and testing in a 10-day foundation course. Explore the course outline.
lede: React Native app development covers building and testing reusable mobile features for Android and iOS. For aspiring mobile developers, frontend developers, and software testers, the course practises creating a small cross-platform app through TypeScript components, screen navigation, REST and JSON integration, local data handling, API error states, and Jest-based interaction tests.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who need to contribute to cross-platform app features, test mobile behavior, or move from frontend coding into React Native development.
modules: React Native Runtime and Project Setup
JSX Components and React Native UI
State and Forms with React Hooks
REST and JSON in React Native
prerequisites: Basic computer use and willingness to write and debug code are expected. Prior React Native experience is not required; JavaScript familiarity is helpful but not assumed. Coding is required to complete the practical exercises. Bring a laptop and install Node.js, React Native CLI, Git, and Android Studio before hands-on sessions. iOS simulator exercises require a Mac with Xcode; learners without that setup can complete the Android-focused practical work and review iOS build concepts.
